56171-a-journey-in-brazil.title: Journey In Brazil.
56171-a-journey-in-brazil.creator: Professor And Mrs. Louis Agassiz.
56171-a-journey-in-brazil.description: A book by Professor And Mrs. Louis Agassiz.. r for the purpose, was an additional incentive. I knew that the head of the government would give me every facility for my investigations. Nevertheless, tempting as was the prospect of a visit to Brazil, as a mere vacation it had little charm for me.

arxiv-1907-10279.title: A Forensic Audit of the Tor Browser Bundle Journal: Digital Investigation
arxiv-1907-10279.creator: Matt Muir, Petra Leimich and William J Buchanan
arxiv-1907-10279.description: Abstract The increasing use of encrypted data within file storage and in network communications leaves investigators with many challenges. One of the most challenging is the Tor protocol, as its main focus is to protect the privacy of the user, in both its local footprint within a host and over a network connection.

arxiv-2001-09565.title: Phase diagrams of interacting spreading dynamics in complex networks
arxiv-2001-09565.creator: Liming Pan, Dan Yang, Wei Wang, Shimin Cai, Tao Zhou, Ying-Cheng Lai
arxiv-2001-09565.description: Abstract Epidemic spreading processes in the real world can interact with each other in a cooperative, competitive, or asymmetric way, requiring a description based on coevolution dynamics. Rich phenomena such as discontinuous outbreak transitions and hystereses can arise, but a full picture of these behaviors in the parameter space is lacking.

arxiv-2102-06135.title: Pseudojump inversion in special r. b. Π 1 0 \Pi^{0}_{1} classes
arxiv-2102-06135.creator: Hayden R. Jananthan
arxiv-2102-06135.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hayden R. Jananthan. The Jump Inversion Theorem says that for every real A ≥ T 0 ′ A\geq_{\mathrm{T}}0^{\prime} there is a real B B such that A ≡ T B ′ ≡ T B ⊕ 0 ′ A\equiv_{\mathrm{T}}B^{\prime}\equiv_{\mathrm{T}}B\oplus 0^{\prime} . A known refinement of this theorem says that we can choose B B to be a member of any special Π 1 0 \Pi^{0}_{1} subclass of { 0 , 1 } ℕ \{0,1\}^{\mathbb{N}} .

arxiv-2106-07716.title: OVERCOMING DOMAIN MISMATCH IN LOW RESOURCE SEQUENCE-TO-SEQUENCE ASR MODELS USING HYBRID GENERATED PSEUDOTRANSCRIPTS
arxiv-2106-07716.creator: Chak-Fai Li, Francis Keith, William Hartmann, Matthew Snover, Owen Kimball
arxiv-2106-07716.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chak-Fai Li, Francis Keith, William Hartmann, Matthew Snover, Owen Kimball. Sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models are competitive with hybrid models for automatic speech recognition (ASR) tasks when large amounts of training data are available. However, data sparsity and domain adaptation are more problematic for seq2seq models than their hybrid counterparts. We examine corpora of five languages from the IARPA MATERIAL program where the transcribed data is conversational telephone speech (CTS) and evaluation data is broadcast news (BN).

arxiv-2203-06410.title: Kernel Proposal Network for Arbitrary Shape Text Detection
arxiv-2203-06410.creator: Shi-Xue Zhang, Xiaobin Zhu, Jie-Bo Hou, Chun Yang, Xu-Cheng Yin
arxiv-2203-06410.description: Abstract Segmentation-based methods have achieved great success for arbitrary shape text detection. However, separating neighboring text instances is still one of the most challenging problems due to the complexity of texts in scene images. In this paper, we propose an innovative Kernel Proposal Network (dubbed KPN) for arbitrary shape text detection.

arxiv-2207-13333.title: Knowledge-driven Subword Grammar Modeling for Automatic Speech Recognition in Tamil and Kannada Journal: Pattern Recognition
arxiv-2207-13333.creator: Madhavaraj A, Bharathi Pilar, Ramakrishnan A. G
arxiv-2207-13333.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Madhavaraj A, Bharathi Pilar, Ramakrishnan A. G. In this paper, we present specially designed automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems for the highly agglutinative and inflective languages of Tamil and Kannada that can recognize unlimited vocabulary of words. We use subwords as the basic lexical units for recognition and construct subword grammar weighted finite state transducer (SG-WFST) graphs for word segmentation that captures most of the complex word formation rules of the languages.

arxiv-2212-06979.title: Fast parametric two-qubit gate for highly detuned fixed-frequency superconducting qubits using a double-transmon coupler
arxiv-2212-06979.creator: Kentaro Kubo, Hayato Goto
arxiv-2212-06979.description: Abstract High-performance two-qubit gates have been reported with superconducting qubits coupled via a single-transmon coupler (STC). Most of them are implemented for qubits with a small detuning since reducing residual Z ​ Z ZZ coupling for highly detuned qubits by an STC is challenging. In terms of the frequency crowding and crosstalk, however, highly detuned qubits are desirable.

arxiv-2407-12062.title: Multistep Brent Oil Price Forecasting with a Multi-Aspect Meta-heuristic Optimization and Ensemble Deep Learning Model
arxiv-2407-12062.creator: Mohammed Alruqimi, Luca Di Persio
arxiv-2407-12062.description: Abstract Accurate crude oil price forecasting is crucial for various economic activities, including energy trading, risk management, and investment planning. Although deep learning models have emerged as powerful tools for crude oil price forecasting, achieving accurate forecasts remains challenging. Deep learning models’ performance is heavily influenced by hyperparameters tuning, and they are expected to perform differently under various circumstances.

arxiv-2501-10144.title: A Vision-Language Framework for Multispectral Scene Representation Using Language-Grounded Features
arxiv-2501-10144.creator: Enes Karanfil, Nevrez Imamoglu, Erkut Erdem, Aykut Erdem {enes.karanfil,nevrez.imamoglu}@aist.go.jperkut@cs.hacettepe.edu.traerdem@ku.edu.tr
arxiv-2501-10144.description: Abstract Scene understanding in remote sensing often faces challenges in generating accurate representations for complex environments such as various land use areas or coastal regions, which may also include snow, clouds or haze. To address this, we present a vision-language framework named Spectral-LLaVA, which integrates multispectral data with vision-language alignment techniques to enhance scene representation and description.

arxiv-2503-03551.title: Zhuk’s bridges, centralizers, and similarity Thanks: The support of the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council (NSERC) of Canada is gratefully acknowledged.
arxiv-2503-03551.creator: Ross Willard
arxiv-2503-03551.description: Abstract . This is the second of three papers motivated by the author’s desire to understand and explain “algebraically” one aspect of Dmitriy Zhuk’s proof of the CSP Dichotomy Theorem. In this paper we extend Zhuk’s “bridge” construction to arbitrary meet-irreducible congruences of finite algebras in locally finite varieties with a Taylor term.

arxiv-2506-14958.title: Long-Range Entangling Operations via Josephson Junction Metasurfaces Thanks: M. Bakr acknowledges support from EPSRC QT Fellowship Grant EP/W027992/1.
arxiv-2506-14958.creator: Mustafa Bakr
arxiv-2506-14958.description: Abstract We present a framework for implementing two-qubit entangling operations between distant superconducting qubits using a space–time modulated Josephson junction (JJ) metasurface. By modulating the surface in both space and time, we engineer sidebands with controllable wavevectors that selectively couple target qubits.

arxiv-2509-09241.title: A NOVEL METHOD AND DATASET FOR DEPTH-GUIDED IMAGE DEBLURRING FROM SMARTPHONE LIDAR
arxiv-2509-09241.creator: Antonio Montanaro, Diego Valsesia
arxiv-2509-09241.description: Abstract Modern smartphones are equipped with Lidar sensors providing depth-sensing capabilities. Recent works have shown that this complementary sensor allows to improve various tasks in image processing, including deblurring. However, there is a current lack of datasets with realistic blurred images and paired mobile Lidar depth maps to further study the topic.

pmc-10541404.title: Fresh and frozen cardiac tissue are comparable in DNA methylation array β-values, but formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissue may overestimate DNA methylation levels
pmc-10541404.creator: Mikkel Eriksen Dupont, Stine Bøttcher Jacobsen, Steffan Noe Niikanoff Christiansen, Jacob Tfelt-Hansen, Morten Holdgaard Smerup, Jeppe Dyrberg Andersen, Niels Morling
pmc-10541404.description: Untreated fresh cardiac tissue is the optimal tissue material for investigating DNA methylation patterns of cardiac biology and diseases. However, fresh tissue is difficult to obtain. Therefore, tissue stored as frozen or formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded (FFPE) is widely used for DNA methylation studies. It is unknown whether storage conditions alter the DNA methylation in cardiac tissue.

pmc-10629397.title: Identification of Genes Associated with Decreasing Abundance of Monocytes in Long-Term Peritoneal Dialysis Patients
pmc-10629397.creator: Yinghui Zhang, Yanhua Jin, Huan Wang, Long He, Yanning Zhang, Qi Liu, Yu Xin, Xueyu Li
pmc-10629397.description: PurposeChronic kidney disease (CKD) will become an end-stage renal disease (ESRD) at stage 5. Peritoneal dialysis (PD) is required for renal replacement therapy. This study aims to identify monocytes-related genes in peritoneal cells from long-term PD (LPD) patients and short-term PD (SPD) patients.

pmc-10699053.title: Effects of electroacupuncture on imaging and behavior in rats with ischemic stroke through miR-212-5p
pmc-10699053.creator: Sisi Li, Xiangxin Xing, Xuyun Hua, Yuwen Zhang, Jiajia Wu, Chunlei Shan, Mouxiong Zheng, He Wang, Jianguang Xu
pmc-10699053.description: BackgroundIschemic stroke is a serious disease leading to significant disability in humans worldwide. Increasing evidence suggests that some microRNAs (miRNAs) participate in the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. A key role for MiR-212 has been found in neuronal function and synaptic plasticity.

pmc-10715511.title: Are housing circumstances associated with faster epigenetic ageing?
pmc-10715511.creator: Amy Clair, Emma Baker, Meena Kumari
pmc-10715511.description: BackgroundNumerous aspects of housing are associated with health. However, the pathways between housing and health, particularly the psychosocial elements of housing, are less well understood. Epigenetic information alongside social survey data offers an opportunity to explore biological ageing, measured using DNA methylation, as a potential pathway through which housing affects health.

pmc-10957779.title: Antibiotic therapy impact on intravesical BCG therapy efficacy for high-risk localized bladder cancer treatment
pmc-10957779.creator: Cécile Aubert, Thibaut Culty, Merzouka Zidane, Pierre Bigot, Souhil Lebdai
pmc-10957779.description: Intravesical Bacillus Calmettes-Guerin (BCG) instillations is the gold standard adjuvant treatment for high and very high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC). Antibiotics may be required to treat asymptomatic bacteriuria before instillations or to prevent side effects. By modifying the bladder microbiota and through its bactericidal action, it could modify the efficacy of BCG.

pmc-11299720.title: Italian Patient Satisfaction with wAMD Management: SWAN Study Results
pmc-11299720.creator: Enrico Peiretti, Chiara Ascardi, Francesco Bandello, Francesco Boscia, Monica Varano, Marta Bartezaghi, Lorenzo De Santi, Giovanni Staurenghi
pmc-11299720.description: PurposeLimited data is available on treatment satisfaction with the management of wet age-related macular degeneration (wAMD) among patients in Italy. In this cross-sectional real-world study, treatment satisfaction with anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGFs) was assessed in patients with wAMD in Italy.Patients and MethodsThis was a non-interventional, cross-sectional survey involving patients with wAMD receiving anti-VEGFs.

pmc-11481279.title: SARS-CoV-2 ORF 3a-mediated currents are inhibited by antiarrhythmic drugs
pmc-11481279.creator: Felix Wiedmann, Emika Boondej, Megan Stanifer, Amelie Paasche, Manuel Kraft, Merten Prüser, Timon Seeger, Ulrike Uhrig, Steeve Boulant, Constanze Schmidt
pmc-11481279.description: AimsCoronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), has been linked to cardiovascular complications, notably cardiac arrhythmias. The open reading frame (ORF) 3a of the coronavirus genome encodes for a transmembrane protein that can function as an ion channel.

pmc-12467377.title: Neuroprotective Effects of Low-Intensity Pulsed Ultrasound in Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy Induced by Repetitive Head Collisions: A Narrative Review
pmc-12467377.creator: Min Zhang, Liang Zhao, Paulo Cesar Lock Silveira
pmc-12467377.description: Simple SummarySports collisions significantly contribute to the increase in neurodegenerative diseases. Chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) is one of the common neurodegenerative conditions athletes often face in contact sports, with no cure, because the symptoms are similar to other conditions like AD and PD. Early diagnosis can be difficult, which may cause the condition to worsen.

pmc-12490348.title: Plain language summary of a systematic review of palbociclib treatment for advanced/ metastatic breast cancer in older patients
pmc-12490348.creator: Etienne Brain, Connie Chen, Sofia Simon, Vinay Pasupuleti, Kathleen Vieira Pfitzer, Karen A Gelmon
pmc-12490348.description: Plain Language Summary What is this summary about? This plain language summary is about a systematic review of articles that reported on palbociclib treatment in older patients with breast cancer who were diagnosed with a type of advanced or metastatic breast cancer called hormone receptor-positive/ human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HR+/HER2−).

pmc-12583040.title: The extracellular matrix in peripheral nerve repair and regeneration: a narrative review of its role and therapeutic potential
pmc-12583040.creator: Miriam Metafune, Luisa Muratori, Federica Fregnan, Giulia Ronchi, Stefania Raimondo
pmc-12583040.description: The extracellular matrix (ECM) is a non-cellular and gelatinous component of tissues, rich in proteins and proteoglycans, that provides information about the environment, forms a reservoir of trophic factors and regulates cell behavior by binding and activating cell surface receptors.

pmc-13212987.title: Additive-free and brine-discharge-free solar-thermal desalination with simultaneous complete mineral mining from ocean water
pmc-13212987.creator: Luheng Tang, Subhash C Singh, Ran Wei, Tianshu Xu, Chunlei Guo
pmc-13212987.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Solar-thermal interfacial desalination is a sustainable solution to meet the ever-increasing global freshwater demand. However, when treating actual ocean water, salt accumulation on the evaporator surfaces and brine discharge are major issues limiting the performance and posing environmental concerns.

pmc-13349953.title: Th1–2 immune balance revisited: refining prognostic immune signatures in colorectal cancer
pmc-13349953.creator: Clara Meier, Angela Brieger

pmc-13352852.title: DDX5 (p68) and UbE2T as emerging superior cancer therapeutic targets: dual molecular glue target degradation by FL118 for conquering difficult-to-treat cancers
pmc-13352852.creator: Fengzhi Li, Xiang Ling, Sayan Chakraborty, Dean G. Tang, Karen McLean, Wenjie Wu, Norbert Sule, Deepak Vadehra, Christos Fountzilas, Ajay Gupta, Clare Twist, Joyce Ohm, Gurkamal Chatta, Scott I. Abrams
pmc-13352852.description: Growing evidence has revealed that DEAD-box RNA helicase 5 (DDX5, also known as p68) and ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme E2T (UbE2T) are two emerging and highly promising cancer therapeutic targets. This article provides the first comprehensive review of the physical and functional relationship between these two cancer targets, further refining their therapeutic potentials in solid cancers.

pmc-13399866.title: Lateral Extra‐articular Tenodesis Utilizing Modified Ellison Technique With Knotless Anchor Fixation
pmc-13399866.creator: Joseph M Sliepka, Natalie K Kucirek, Alan L Zhang

pmc-13536399.title: Influence of finish line quality and axial surface location on marginal adaptation of selective laser melting fabricated copings
pmc-13536399.creator: Chun-Yu Wang, Hsuan Chen, Chih-Yu Hsu, Yen-Chun Liu, Jen-Chih Chao, Shyh-Yuan Lee
pmc-13536399.description: Background/purposeThe digital transition in dentistry necessitates reexamining traditional preparation standards, particularly finish-line quality for 3D-printed restorations. This study investigated how finish-line characteristics affect the marginal adaptation of selective laser melting (SLM) fabricated copings.Materials and methodsForty typodont maxillary central incisors prepared for porcelain-fused- to-metal crowns were scanned. Margin width, margin curvature, and finish-line curvature were measured at four axial surfaces.

pmc-13561870.title: Structural and functional basis of antinociceptive action of χ-conotoxin AoIA at the noradrenaline transporter
pmc-13561870.creator: Oliver J. V. Belleza, Heng Zhang, Helmut Schmidhammer, Tye I. Gonzalez, Cosmin I. Ciotu, Nataša Tomašević, Carlo Martin M. Ocampo, Jomari C. Fernando, Johannes Koehbach, Paula Schwarz, Mounaf Al Makhlouf, Gabor Tajti, Simon Hasinger, Nina Kastner, Orcun Avsar, Bernhard Retzl, Kathrin Jäntsch, Yi Jia
pmc-13561870.description: The χ-conotoxins are venom-derived peptides that specifically target the noradrenaline transporter (also known as norepinephrine transporter, NET). Regulation of noradrenergic signaling by NET affects neurophysiological processes, including pain. Therefore, the χ-conotoxin MrIA and its synthetic analogs have been previously investigated for their analgesic activity.

pmc-13673735.title: Hypoparathyroidism-related Fahr syndrome presenting with new-onset seizures: a case report
pmc-13673735.creator: Sishir Poudel, Laxman Wagle, Aashutosh Jha, Rashmita Regmi, Ayushma Dhungana
pmc-13673735.description: BackgroundHypocalcemia secondary to hypoparathyroidism can cause basal ganglia calcification which can act as epileptogenic focus and produce neuropsychiatric manifestations. This is termed Fahr syndrome.Case presentationA 36-year-old Nepalese female with hypoparathyroidism and history of anxiety disorder presented with generalized seizures. She was found to have bilateral calcification in brain consistent with Fahr syndrome.
